questions.question: King Jeroboam sent his wife in disguise to Shiloh to ask a prophet about their sick son. Who was the prophet?
Through the prophet Ahijah, God said King Jeroboam had done more evil than anyone before him. What had he made for himself?
Through the prophet Ahijah, God said He was bringing disaster on King Jeroboam's family. What would He do to it?

answers.text: Cut off every male in it
Make it serve the house of David

questions.question: Of all King Jeroboam's family, only his sick son Abijah would get a proper burial. Why him?

answers.text: The LORD found some good in him
He asked for the prophet's help
